item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: User-bound user delegation SAS for Azure Storage
item.description:
Azure Storage now generally available with user-bound user delegation SAS, combining user delegation SAS flexibility with Entra ID user-bound access for stronger authentication. The update adds enhanced secure authentication for Azure Storage.

  • Source: Azure Updates
